text.name: TextDesc2
text.text: WASM-4 is an open-source fantasy console designed for creating small retro-style games that run through WebAssembly. Released in 2021, it provides a minimal hardware-like environment with fixed graphics, sound, input, and memory limits inspired by classic consoles. Games can be developed using many programming languages that compile to WebAssembly, making WASM-4 accessible for experimentation, game jams, and learning game development.
